reviews.title: Exceedingly capable homelab streaming and remote rendering card.
reviews.comment: Purchased for a homelab rack server running Linux and Plex and some other tools. Highly recommend for a lower cost modern high performance card, it isn't power hungry, and is very stable while it handles transcoding for multiple streams. The only downside I found was that HDMI output for large resolutions was highly limited due to the output path being native for display port and the HDMI bridge being lower speed; my display was just above the capability of the HDMI output, so I had to switch to the HDMI output from the CPU chipset.
reviews.author: Christopher Chapman

reviews.title: A PLEX reencoding monster
reviews.comment: Excellent value video when encoding for a PLEX server. I wanted to utilize the highly efficient AV1 codec and board storms through high quality conversions. AV1 plays fine on almost everything these days on PLEX with some device file configuration updates.
reviews.author: Jay C. Medeiros

reviews.title: Great Media Encoding Transcoding GPU
reviews.comment: I like this GPU for its media handling capabilities. It can encode, decode or transcode AV1 along with other codecs rapidly which was my primary reason for getting the A380. The 3D performance isn't award winning when I tried gaming with it, but lighter lower requirement or low graphic gaming worked really well. It's not a Cyberpunk 2077 GPU unless you like lower FPS gaming, just letting people know. Stability is much better considering Intel has spend a lot of time improving the drivers over the years. I'm happy about that. It does what I need it to do quite well, so it's a great lower powered GPU with a good value attached to it that I would recommend. Power consumption is pretty good, however the one thing I didn't like is the above average idle power consumption. That's the only issue I had with it and is why I reduced 1 star from my review. I even did all of the recommend adjustments that works for some, but it didn't do anything for me unfortunately.
reviews.author: IammE

reviews.title: Solid for the money
reviews.comment: This gpu is fantastic. Dont let anyone tell you otherwise. If you are building a first desktop, this gpu will be enough for you. Especially coming from a laptop. This particular variant of the a380 pushes 4 teraflops and can boost up to 5. That is close to and equal to series s. It runs every game ive tried so well. It beats the tar out of integrated graphics. Temper your expectations if you are coming from a more powerful gpu than this. Its not gonna be a monster but its a very good deal for the money.
reviews.author: Average consumer

reviews.title: No HDMI prior to kernel loading if rebar/above 4g enabled
reviews.comment: Purchased this to use for hardware encoding/decoding and object detection using the OpenVino framework in Frigate. Card probably works fine, but there's no signal on the HDMI port prior to the kernel loading when rebar/above 4G decoding are enabled, which makes troubleshooting problematic with a KVM over IP that uses HDMI. Very disappointed.
reviews.author: frank
